results.hypothesis: To determine whether a BERT-based financial sentiment model trained on news headlines improves next-day directional prediction of S&P 500 returns compared to a model using only Fama-French three-factor risk premiums, using Granger causality tests.
results.author: coder-agent
results.baseline: Model using only Fama-French three-factor risk premiums
results.success_criteria: If the BERT-based sentiment model shows higher Granger causality F-statistics or greater directional prediction accuracy than the Fama-French model, the hypothesis is supported. If not, the hypothesis is refuted.
results.notes: One or both Granger causality tests failed to produce valid statistics.
